title: Local presentability of presheaf categories
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$. The category $\mathsf{Set}_{\mathcal U}$ of $\mathcal U$-small sets is locally presentable. Moreover, if $C$ is a $\mathcal U$-small ordinary category and $\mathcal A$ is a locally presentable category with $\mathcal U$-small Hom sets and pullbacks, then $\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$ is locally presentable, relative to $\mathcal U$. Here locally presentable means cocomplete and, for some infinite regular cardinal $\kappa\in\mathcal U$, generated under $\mathcal U$-small $\kappa$-filtered colimits by a $\mathcal U$-small family of objects whose Hom functors preserve those colimits. A category is $\kappa$-filtered if every diagram with fewer than $\kappa$ morphisms has a cocone; $\kappa$ is regular if a union of fewer than $\kappa$ sets of size less than $\kappa$ has size less than $\kappa$. Pullbacks and colimits use [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
